summary: Four listed churches (Our Lady of Hope, St. Ann's, St. Mary's, Chapel of the Assumption) share one bulletin whose page 2 schedule box is identical in all five issues read. Weekend, weekday, Adoration and Confession times are settled from it, with a split Monday-Tuesday adoration period at Our Lady of Hope and a November-only Knights of Columbus Holy Hour at St. Mary's. The chapel's Saturday 6 PM Mass is excluded because the parish website limits it to Memorial Day through Columbus Day. No open questions.
